model.name: diagram.zoomOutGrows
model.description: R33.7.1 INV-Z1 (design 8aa19d090): zoom-out grows the working canvas. RbPanZoom MIN lowered 1->0.25 (zoom-OUT enabled; wheel/pinch already call zoomAbout) + clamp() extended: at scale<1 CENTER content (tx/ty=(vw-vw*s)/2) instead of the >=1 edge-clamp -> zoom-out reveals placeable canvas around the diagram; viewBox canvas-pad (diagram-view-model.ts:105, call-site) makes the margin REAL space (composes R33.6.2). 1=100%=whole-diagram, <1=grown canvas, >1=magnify. Client-only, reuse RbPanZoom clamp/apply, no fork. Singular=the setScale/zoom-range seam; MIN const + clamp edit + viewBox pad are edits/call-sites.
